# mycelial-cognition-architecture

> Defensive publication (public domain): Spore 001 — the Mycelial Cognition Architecture, distributed AI orchestration with stability by symmetry.

mycelial-cognition-architecture is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
